description: Summarize one run from okgate's audit log: how many tool calls, what dry-run mode faked (records it would have created, updated or deleted, messages sent, dollars spent), what really ran upstream, and every call okgate halted with its code and cause. Defaults to the most recent run. Use it after an agent run, before switching a policy from dry-run to enforce; for live caps and the kill switch use okgate_get_status. Read-only: reads the audit file and does not record this call.

run_id.description: Run to read, as it appears in the audit log (for example run_20261007093015_ab12, or the X-Run-Id an HTTP client sent). Omit it for the most recent run.

name: okgate_get_report

audit_log_path.description: absolute path of the audit log the report was built from

configured.description: false when no policy file was found (okgate guards nothing)

halts.description: every call okgate stopped, in order

markdown.description: the same report `okgate report` prints, as Markdown

run_id.description: the run reported on; null when the log has no runs

runs_in_log.description: how many runs the audit log holds

top_tools.description: the most-called tools with their class (read, write, spend)

would_have.description: what dry-run mode faked: what the run would have done had the calls executed

title: okgate run report
